pieces.tagline: A majestic emblem of strength, hand-sculpted to command presence.
pieces.name: Felina
pieces.story:
A powerful statement of resilience, Felina I embodies the untamed spirit and majestic gaze of its namesake. The cuff wraps around the wrist as a bold, architectural talisman, with every sculpted feature captured in deep, evocative relief. It is more than a piece of adornment; it is a wearable totem for those who walk with purpose and quiet authority.

Handcrafted via the traditional lost-wax technique by a single master artisan, this limited-edition artefact bridges the gap between ancient symbolism and modern design. The deliberate surface textures are preserved as the proud signature of the maker—serving as tangible proof of a human touch in a machine-made age.
